subtitle: I've asked my aunt to tell me this story at least fifteen times.

captions.instagram:
Secrets: Five Days Before Christmas, 1990.

My older sister, two years old, was playing with her doll under a Christmas tree sprayed with fake snow. My grandparents were half watching sports highlights. And my mother, nine months pregnant, was about to slip away.

Swipe through.

From Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.
